t: 苏格兰贵族在选举国王之前承认英格兰爱德华一世的权威。
te: Scottish nobles recognize the authority of Edward I of England pending the selection of a king.
dz: 苏格兰贵族在选举国王之前承认英格兰爱德华一世的权威。
de: Scottish nobles recognize the authority of Edward I of England pending the selection of a king.

t: 阿克里的倒下,十字军在圣地存在的终结.
te: Fall of Acre, the end of Crusader presence in the Holy Land.
dz: 阿克里的倒下,十字军在圣地存在的终结.
de: Fall of Acre, the end of Crusader presence in the Holy Land.

t: 旧瑞士联邦随着联邦宪章的签署而成立。
te: The Old Swiss Confederacy is formed with the signature of the Federal Charter.
dz: 旧瑞士联邦随着联邦宪章的签署而成立。
de: The Old Swiss Confederacy is formed with the signature of the Federal Charter.

t: 威尼斯共和国颁布了一项法律,将威尼斯的大部分玻璃制造工业限制在"村野岛".
te: The Republic of Venice enacts a law confining most of Venice's glassmaking industry to the "island of Murano".
dz: 威尼斯共和国颁布了一项法律,将威尼斯的大部分玻璃制造工业限制在"村野岛".
de: The Republic of Venice enacts a law confining most of Venice's glassmaking industry to the "island of Murano".
